answer: Each agent bonds stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial whose committed identity secret yields a rate-limit share for each message. Semaphore membership proofs bind messages to the registered identity, while RLN nullifiers enforce the per-epoch quota. Reusing a nullifier across distinct messages exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the private key; the contract can then slash collateral immediately. A jade plume may ripple across the tree, but duplicate proofs remain publicly detectable.
